session-control: Launch, message, wake and end agent sessions.
session-control acceptance run: Run the session control acceptance check.
session-control evidence: Read a session's logs from its own machine.
session-control evidence get: Read a session's log file from its own machine.
session-control keepalive: Keep idle sessions from being ended.
session-control keepalive hold: Keep one idle session from being ended for a time.
session-control keepalive release: Let one session be ended when idle again.
session-control launch: Start agent sessions and track their launches.
session-control launch create: Start a new agent session for an item or task.
session-control launch list: List session launches in a project.
session-control launch preview: Show where a launch would run, without starting it.
session-control launch reconcile: Settle a launch whose outcome is unknown.
session-control message: Send, read and acknowledge messages between sessions.
session-control message acknowledge: Mark a message you received as acted on.
session-control message cancel: Cancel a message that is not yet read.
session-control message get: Show one message and its delivery receipts.
session-control message list: List messages and their delivery receipts.
session-control message preview: Show who a message would reach, without sending.
session-control message send: Send a message to people and sessions.
session-control qualification: Open qualification records for session surfaces.
session-control qualification open: Open a qualification record for a session surface.
session-control session terminate: End one session and release its claims.
session-control surface-policy: Turn session surfaces on or off per machine.
session-control surface-policy disable: Stop launching sessions on a surface and machine.
session-control surface-policy enable: Allow launching sessions on a surface and machine.
session-control surface-policy list: List surfaces turned off on machines.
